metadata.purpose: Inject into image/video prompts so the same concept always evokes the same animal symbol across all daily-study artifacts
design_rules: Each symbol should be an ANIMAL or animal-action whenever possible
Symbol should evoke the receptor name phonetically OR its clinical function
Same animal across all images for the same entity (color/size/action can vary)
When a drug TARGETS the receptor, depict the drug interacting with the animal (chained, fed, blocked, riding, etc.)
Antagonist = chains/cage/muzzle. Agonist = feeding/freeing/riding. Inverse agonist = mirror/upside-down.

D1_receptor.visual: A sparkling beetle with a diamond-shaped shell, jumping/active
D1_receptor.function_link: Gs → excitatory. 'D-1' → 'Diamond, first-class'. Beetle jumping = excitation.
D1_receptor.use_when: PFC dopamine, motor activation, working memory, D1-family discussions

D2_receptor.category: Dopamine receptor (Gi, inhibitory) — most clinically important
D2_receptor.visual: A large brown bear with TWO prominent ears (D-2). When antipsychotic acts → bear is chained/muzzled. When psychosis → bear is wild and roaring.
D2_receptor.function_link: D2 antagonism = THE antipsychotic mechanism. Bear must be tamed.
D2_receptor.use_when: Antipsychotics, schizophrenia, EPS, hyperprolactinemia (bear pulls 'milk' chain)

D3_receptor.visual: A slow sloth hanging from limbic-shaped tree branches
D3_receptor.function_link: D-3 → three toes. Limbic distribution → emotional/slow. Cariprazine targets D3.
D3_receptor.use_when: Cariprazine, limbic dopamine, addiction circuits, anhedonia

D4_receptor.visual: An octopus with exactly 4 highlighted arms holding a clozapine pill
D4_receptor.function_link: D-4 → four arms. Clozapine binds D4 prominently. Limited motor side effects.

D5_receptor.animal: Five-pointed Starfish (כוכב ים בעל חמש זרועות)
D5_receptor.visual: A purple starfish with 5 limbs, on a hippocampus-shaped seabed
D5_receptor.function_link: D-5 → five points. Hippocampal distribution. D1-family co-member.
D5_receptor.use_when: Memory, hippocampal dopamine. Less common in daily clinical context.

5-HT1A_receptor.visual: A calm owl sitting on a branch — eyes closed, meditating. Buspirone offers it a peace pipe.
5-HT1A_receptor.function_link: 5-HT-ONE-A → 'OWL-A'. Calm/wise owl = anxiolytic effect. Partial agonists (buspirone, vilazodone, vortioxetine, aripiprazole) feed the owl.
5-HT1A_receptor.use_when: Buspirone, vilazodone, vortioxetine, aripiprazole, serotonergic anxiolysis

5-HT2A_receptor.category: Serotonin receptor (Gq, cortical) — antipsychotic + psychedelic target
5-HT2A_receptor.visual: A striped tiger with TWO heads facing opposite directions — one hallucinating (psychedelic), one antipsychotic-blocked
5-HT2A_receptor.function_link: 5-HT-TWO-A. Psychedelics (LSD) = agonist → hallucinating head free. Atypical antipsychotics = antagonist → muzzle on the other head.
5-HT2A_receptor.use_when: All atypical antipsychotics, hallucinogens, pimavanserin (inverse agonist), trazodone, mirtazapine

5-HT2C_receptor.visual: A round, well-fed cougar guarding a cookie jar. When 2C is BLOCKED (mirtazapine, olanzapine) — the cougar steals all the cookies → weight gain.
5-HT2C_receptor.function_link: 5-HT-2-C → 2 Cs (Chubby Cougar with Cookies). Blockade → ↑appetite, weight gain. Activation (lorcaserin) → weight loss.
5-HT2C_receptor.use_when: Weight gain side effects of mirtazapine/olanzapine/quetiapine, lorcaserin (withdrawn), trazodone

5-HT3_receptor.category: Serotonin receptor (LIGAND-GATED ION CHANNEL — unique!) — GI/CTZ
5-HT3_receptor.visual: A snake with 3 hissing heads in the gut — vomiting fire. Ondansetron caps each head. Mirtazapine and vortioxetine also block.
5-HT3_receptor.function_link: 5-HT-3 → three heads. The ONLY ionotropic 5-HT receptor. Located on CTZ + gut = nausea/vomiting.
5-HT3_receptor.use_when: Nausea, vomiting, mirtazapine antiemetic effect, vortioxetine, antiemetics (ondansetron family)

5-HT6_receptor.animal: Six-legged Centipede in a thinking cap (נדל בעל שש רגליים)
5-HT6_receptor.visual: A centipede with 6 emphasized legs wearing a tiny graduation cap, helping a brain study
5-HT6_receptor.function_link: 5-HT-6 → six legs. Cognitive enhancement target. Antagonism → procognitive (some atypicals).
5-HT6_receptor.use_when: Cognition in schizophrenia, vortioxetine (5-HT6 antagonist), procognitive effects

5-HT7_receptor.animal: Seven Swans circling a clock (שבעה ברבורים)
5-HT7_receptor.visual: Seven swans flying in a circle around a 7 o'clock clock-face (circadian rhythm)
5-HT7_receptor.function_link: 5-HT-7 → seven swans. Circadian rhythm + mood. Lurasidone is a key antagonist (antidepressant effect).
5-HT7_receptor.use_when: Lurasidone, circadian rhythm disorders, bipolar depression, vortioxetine

SERT.visual: A sponge-like fish vacuuming up serotonin molecules from the synapse. SSRI = a cork plugging the sponge's intake.
SERT.function_link: SERT pulls serotonin BACK into presynaptic neuron. Block it → more serotonin in synapse.
SERT.use_when: All SSRIs, SNRIs, TCAs (some), vortioxetine, SARIs
